description: This file defines the 'About' page component for a React-based web application, utilizing Tailwind CSS for styling. The component displays information about a freelance architect's profile, philosophy, education, and a call-to-action section. It is a functional component exporting default and contains mainly static UI content with no complex logic.

methods.name: AboutPage
methods.description: React functional component rendering the 'About Me' page with profile, philosophy, education, and contact call-to-action sections.
